title: Exact byte-level probabilities from tokenized language models for FIM-tasks and model ensembles
authors: B Phan, B Amos, I Gat, M Havasi…
abstract: Tokenization is associated with many poorly understood shortcomings in language models (LMs), yet remains an important component for long sequence scaling purposes. This work studies how tokenization impacts model performance by analyzing and comparing the stochastic behavior of tokenized models with their byte-level, or token-free, counterparts.
